你好！我介绍了我使用 Flux.2 Klein 9B for ComfyUI 的工作流程。

我已将工作流程包含在 Flux.2 Klein 9B 模型中

您需要有 Flux.2 Klein 9B KV 模型（https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9b-kv/blob/main/flux-2-klein-9b-kv.safetensors), 剪辑 (https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/vae-text-encorder-for-flux-klein-9b/tree/main/split_files/text_encoders) 和 vae (https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/tree/main/split_files/vae)

如果您需要基础版本 -https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-base-9B/blob/main/flux-2-klein-base-9b.safetensors

还推荐下载 wikeeyang 的 Flux 2 Klein 9B，它给出了更好的结果 -https://civitai.com/models/2339723/flux2-klein-9b-true

https://huggingface.co/datasets/StefanFalkok/ComfyUI_portable_torch_2.13.0_cu130_cp313_sageattention_triton- 我使用 torch 2.13.0cu130 + sageattention + 我的工作流程构建的新 ComfyUI，您还需要下载并安装 CUDA 13.0 (https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda-13-0-0-download-archive）和 VS 代码（https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/downloads/)

如果您遇到问题或发现工作流程存在问题，请发表评论

Hi! I introduce my working workflows with Flux.2 Klein 9B for ComfyUI.

I have included workflows with Flux.2 Klein 9B models

You need to have Flux.2 Klein 9B KV Model (https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9b-kv/blob/main/flux-2-klein-9b-kv.safetensors), clip (https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/vae-text-encorder-for-flux-klein-9b/tree/main/split_files/text_encoders) and vae (https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/tree/main/split_files/vae)

if you need Base version -https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-base-9B/blob/main/flux-2-klein-base-9b.safetensors

also recommend download Flux 2 Klein 9B by wikeeyang, it gives a better result -https://civitai.com/models/2339723/flux2-klein-9b-true

https://huggingface.co/datasets/StefanFalkok/ComfyUI_portable_torch_2.13.0_cu130_cp313_sageattention_triton- my new ComfyUI build with torch 2.13.0cu130 + sageattention + my workflows, also u need download and install CUDA 13.0 (https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda-13-0-0-download-archive) and VS Code (https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/downloads/)

Leave comments if you have trouble or you found the problem with workflows
